title: Optimistic Versioned Update with Jittered Retry
instructions: In `optimistic.py` implement a generic `retry` with capped exponential backoff and full jitter, and a `VersionedStore` whose `update` does a safe read-modify-write. `compare_and_set` is the only atomic primitive (guard it with a lock); build `update` on top of it, retrying only on `ConflictError`.

evidence.label: Sleeps with capped exponential backoff scaled by jitter between attempts
Does not retry non-retryable errors or after the final attempt
update returns the new value, bumps the version, and read raises KeyError for unknown keys
compare_and_set fails for a stale version and leaves the value alone
8 threads of concurrent increments lose no updates
Raises ConflictError once attempts are exhausted
Errors raised by the update function are not retried
Returns the result without sleeping when the first call succeeds
Delay is rng() times the capped exponential bound
